findings.finding: Beneficient's amended and restated SEPA with Yorkville (up to $100M remaining, 32.47M shares registered for resale; the S-1 went effective 2026-08-05 and the 424B3 was filed 2026-08-07) lets the company deliver an advance on any trading day. Yorkville resells at 96% of daily VWAP or 97% of the lowest VWAP over three days, so supply can hit the 10-07 session with no prior announcement.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An advance notice needs no 8-K and is priced off the session's own VWAP, so a draw on 2026-10-07 sells into that session. The registration is effective and the facility has been used before: the shares registered and Yorkville's 13G history. Yorkville's 0% at 09-30 means it holds no inventory now, so any supply that comes is new rather than an overhang already being worked off.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated SEPA draw could be matched to a single session. The name's 12 falls since 2026-09-01 continued down at the next close 9 times (baseline history.events), consistent with a persistent seller but not proof of one.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's 0.22x volume says no large seller hit the tape today. A SEPA draw is an option the company holds, and the price has no reason to hold its exercise on a specific day. If the market had priced a draw for tomorrow, today would show heavy volume or a fall at the close, not a flat intraday leg.
findings.independence: The Yorkville 13G/A (0% at 2026-09-30) confirms the counterparty is active and currently flat, which cuts both ways: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1775734/000110465926113724/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml. The Yorkville prepaid notes ($4M, converting at 92% of the lowest 5-day VWAP, $0.89 floor) are a second Yorkville supply line: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1775734/000149315226037138/form8-k.htm
